# The Elevation Plugin runs in its own container under local management

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Build the Plugin image and install it through atlasctl

atlasctl recorded the Plugin and wrote its container configuration.

## 2. Start Core, which starts the installed Plugin

Observed running services:
```json
[
  "core",
  "plugin-elevation"
]
```

## 3. Discovery shows the Plugin available

SDK `GET /plugins/elevation` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "availability": "available",
  "capabilities": [
    "elevation.lookup"
  ],
  "id": "elevation",
  "release": "1.0.0"
}
```

## 4. A lookup completes across the container boundary

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /plugins/elevation/operations` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<submission>",
  "capability": "elevation.lookup",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 42.001,
    "longitude": -70.999
  }
}
```

→ **202** · Location `/plugins/elevation/operations/<id-2>`
```json
{
  "capability": "elevation.lookup",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 42.001,
    "longitude": -70.999
  },
  "output": null,
  "plugin_id": "elevation",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

Observed outcome:
```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "elevation": 130
}
```

## 5. Stopping Core also stops the Plugin

Observed running services:
```json
[]
```
